Watch: 2 Congress leaders slap each other during ‘vote theft’ protest in Faridabad
articles.summary: Tensions flared during a Faridabad protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, resulting in Congress leaders Parag Sharma and Gajna Lamba clashing. The confrontation began when Sharma was seen slapping Lamba, which sparked immediate retaliation.

articles.title: Why has New Zealand's T20I squad changed ahead of the India series?
articles.summary: New Zealand have made two changes to their T20I squad for the upcoming five-match series against India after Mark Chapman and Zak Foulkes were ruled out with injuries. Allrounder Josh Clarkson and fast bowler Blair Tickner have been called up to replace the injured players.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Sonali recalls Nana's care: Actor remembers his kindness
articles.summary: Sonali Kulkarni calls Nana Patekar a “dear friend” and recalls how caring he was during her pregnancy while promoting ‘Deool’. She praised his unscripted acting and said he lived life on his own terms.

articles.title: Nana Patekar's last film Shakti Shalini pushed to 2027 to avoid clash with Shah Rukh Khan’s King
articles.summary: Aneet Padda's Shakti Shalini has reportedly been pushed from Christmas 2026 to early 2027 to avoid a box-office clash with Shah Rukh Khan's 'King'. According to Mid-Day, the makers are considering a March release, though no date is confirmed.

articles.title: 'KGF' actress Srinidhi Shetty dismisses Rs 8 crore salary rumours
articles.summary: Srinidhi Shetty has denied the rumors surrounding her supposed Rs 7-8 crore salary for films, asserting that her limited filmography makes such figures implausible. She emphasized that her choices in projects are driven by the quality of storytelling rather than monetary factors.

articles.title: Director recalls Rs 7 lakh flight: Ananth remembers Nana Patekar
articles.summary: Ananth Mahadevan says he was privileged to direct Nana Patekar in ‘The Confession of Mary’, which has wrapped shooting with 10 days of post-production left. He recalled Patekar saying the rough cut made him feel like an actor, and how the star once fled the airport on learning a flight’s duration, forfeiting Rs 7 lakh..
